timing: Retrospective extension. Prior scalar variation, rank, floor, human-rater influence, calibration and reversal results known. Complete 55 historical run-tree byte commitments verified before this method. Freeze source/profile and independent review before new raw-label projections.
inputs: Recheck every exact registered run.json and verdicts.jsonl byte descriptor before any selected label parsing. Run manifest projection: configuration.question_ids only. Each JSONL row projection: question_id and verdict only; lexical UTF8 scanning skips remaining JSON fields without materializing their values. No confidence, note, rationale, input prose, native/session response, human target, scorer or provider replay.
missingness: Fail closed on any changed hash, reparse path, absent cell, partial JSONL tail, malformed/unknown label, duplicate question, differing repeat question order or count other than 179. Preserve the full registered cohort; no dropping rare states or failed runs.
subject: An item-question position with five registered repeated outputs. Questions and items are heterogeneous and dependent; repeated outputs are not five independent human raters. Per-item and separate-cohort diagnostics only; never pool rubric versions.
categories: Four stable-state categories, changing_with_yes_and_no (both present, optionally other states), changing_without_yes_and_no (other changing sequences). Mutually exclusive/exhaustive; raw label changes are not canonical score-effective ladder changes.
agreement: Each subject supplies ten unordered repeat-index pairs. Observed nominal agreement Po is equal-subject mean pairwise equal-label fraction. Marginal category probabilities pj use all five outputs per subject in that item or cohort. Pe=sum(pj^2); Fleiss-form descriptive kappa=(Po-Pe)/(1-Pe), null when Pe=1. Exact Fraction arithmetic; no rounding/epsilon or confidence/severity weights. Cohort Po weights items equally because every item has 179 positions. Cohort kappa is not the mean of item kappas.
transition_table: 4x4 cross-tab with earlier registered repeat index on rows, later on columns. Index order is not synchronized wall-clock time, a causal transition or an experimentally changed packet order. Report same-label, YES/NO, assessed-vs-other and NOT_APPLICABLE-vs-CANNOT_ASSESS pair counts as an exhaustive partition.
publication: Aggregate cohort counts/rates and anonymous per-item ordinal rows. Exact item IDs, question IDs and label sequences remain in private evidence. No public rationale, native identity or source-root locator.
interpretation: Prevalence-dependent descriptive nominal repeated-output agreement; chance is a marginal-frequency convention, not a measured random mechanism. Heterogeneous leaf meanings and item/prompt reuse limit interpretation. Different works and rubric versions prevent version causality. No CI, significance, human reliability/correctness, current tools-disabled acceptance, interendpoint comparison, contemporary repeatability qualification or candidate promotion. No judge training or deployed calibration.
